title: Elisha and Hazael in Damascus
description: Elisha arrives in Damascus while the Aramean king Ben-Hadad is ill. The king sends Hazael with rich gifts to ask if he will recover. Elisha answers that the king will die, and tearfully predicts that Hazael himself will become king over Aram and bring terrible disaster upon Israel. The next day, Hazael suffocates the king with a wet blanket and takes the throne.
